_comment: Per-emblem escape hatches for scripts/render-emblems.mjs. Key = GLB basename
(the same key the app uses for the badge). Every field is optional; anything
absent falls back to the script's defaults. The file is empty of real entries
because the defaults currently frame all 25 badges correctly — it exists so
the next model that does not can be fixed without touching the script.
margin           fraction of the half-frame the badge fills (default 0.88)
keepText         true to skip wordmark stripping for this badge
bandMaxYFrac     bottom band height as a fraction of model height (0.35)
bandMinWidthFrac band must span this fraction of model width to count (0.5)
bandMinCount     minimum meshes in the band before it reads as text (3)
